title: Application of Fitchburg Gas and Electric Light Company (1) under the provisions of G.L. c. 164, sec. 94G, as amended by St. 1981, c. 375, and the Company's tariff, M.D.P.U. 199, for approval by the Department of Public Utilities of a change in the quarterly Fuel Charge to be billed to the Company's customers pursuant to meter readings in the billing months of May, June and July, 1987. The Fuel Charge reflects changes in prudently incurred, reasonable costs of fuel and power purchased by the Company; and (2) for approval by the Department of rates to be paid to Qualifying Facilities for purchases of power pursuant to 220 C.M.R. 8.00. The rules established in 220 C.M.R. 8.00 set forth the filings to be made by utilities with the Department, and impllement the intent of sections 201 and 210 of the Public Utilities Regulatory Policies Act of 1978.
